contract_details.contract_period: FROM DATE OF COMPLETION APPROXIMATELY 1/1/83, THROUGH 12/31/83, WITH JANUARY 1, BECOMING THE ANNUAL ANNIVERSARY DATE.
contract_details.cancellation_privileges: ON ANY JANUARY 1, ANNIVERSARY DATE UPON 60 DAYS NOTICE FROM AGENCY WITHOUT PENALTY.
contract_details.copy_changes: The following copy change options will prevail under execution terms of this agreement: If this bulletin/sis to be completely painted there will be 3 complete paintings, including the initial, annually, or; If this bulletin is to be partially posted there will be 6 posting of posted portion and 3 paintings of painted portion, including the initial, annually, or; If this bulletin is to be completely posted, there will be 6 posting, including the initial, annually.
contract_details.special_instructions: PLANT WILL INSTALL HOLOPHANE BY 2/1/83. ALSO 5'X17' EXTENSION SHALL BE TRANSFERRED TO THIS UNIT FROM ONE OF THE ROTARY UNITS BEING DROPPED 1/1/83.
